notes.title: Update 1: 1/23/2023
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for playing the game, we really appreciate the feedback and are glad you all have enjoyed The Palace of Unrest.

This update contains a few fixes and features in response to player feedback:
[list]
[*]Pause menu added with graphics options
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Minor tweaks to the pursuer behavior and attacks
[*]Exploit fixes
[/list]

tags.feature: Pause menu added with graphics options
